detaileddescription.para: This is the class to represent pll nodes.

briefdescription.para: PmPllContext - Structure for saving context of PLL registers.

detaileddescription.para: Contains variable to store default content of: Control register Configuration register Fractional control register Indicates context saved or not
Note: context of the PLL is saved when PM framework suspends a PLL (when no node requires PLL to be locked).

memberdef.argsstring: (u32 Id, u32 ControlReg, u8 TopologyType, const u16 *Offsets, u32 PowerDomainId, u8 ClkFlags)
memberdef.name: XPmClockPll_AddNode

briefdescription.para: Allocates and registers a PLL clock node in the clock database.

parameterdescription.para: Node Id of the PLL clock to add
Base address of the PLL control register
PLL topology type (generic or NoC PLL)
Register offsets for status, config and fractional config
Node Id of the power domain the PLL belongs to
Clock flags for the PLL node

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or error code

inbodydescription.para: Do not suspend the PLL if its use count goes to 0 because it may possible that IOU_SWITCH of other domain is using this PLL. Just decrement its parent use count and PLL will be suspended when its power domain goes off.

briefdescription.para: Asserts or releases the reset of a PLL clock node.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the PLL clock node

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or error code
